questions.question: Which scrolling approach would you like to implement?

options.label: use-stick-to-bottom hook (recommended)
options.description: Battle-tested library already installed. Best performance and configurability. Need to build scroll button UI.

options.label: AI Elements components
options.description: Use existing Conversation/ConversationContent/ConversationScrollButton components. Quick to implement, includes UI.

options.label: Hybrid approach
options.description: Combine use-stick-to-bottom hook for logic with ConversationScrollButton for UI. Best of both worlds.

questions.question: What scroll behavior do you prefer when new messages arrive?

options.label: Smart auto-scroll (current behavior)
options.description: Only auto-scroll if user is near bottom (~200px). Preserves manual scroll position when reading history.

options.label: Always auto-scroll
options.description: Always jump to newest message. Simpler but may interrupt users reviewing chat history.

options.label: Configurable threshold
options.description: Make proximity threshold adjustable (requires use-stick-to-bottom or custom implementation).

questions.question: Should we also update other message/conversation UI components?

options.label: Just scrolling improvements
options.description: Only update scroll behavior and add scroll-to-bottom button. Keep existing message rendering.

options.label: Adopt AI Elements message components
options.description: Replace current message components with Message/MessageAvatar/MessageContent from AI Elements.

options.label: Full conversation refactor
options.description: Replace entire ChatInterface with AI Elements Conversation pattern. Larger refactor.
